metadata.title: बाप के बारे में उदयपुर के लड़के क्या बोले? | Bharat Tribal Party and youth aspirations | Rajasthan
metadata.description:
On September 10th, a significant event took place in the Dungarpur district as a new political entity known as the 'Bharat Adivasi Party' was officially launched. This momentous occasion drew a remarkable crowd of approximately one lakh people, which included both young men and women.

During the foundation convention of this newly formed political party, we had the opportunity to engage with the attendees and gain insight into their perspectives. We inquired whether they held the belief that the establishment of a distinct political party could effectively address their concerns and issues. Additionally, we sought their opinions on the viability of the claimed collective leadership, as asserted by their chosen leaders.

#rajasthanelection2023
